about: linkedin's decision table (the P3 procedure). Every served operation is a handler: a create answers 201 with its URN in a header and no body, every call is checked against its token's scopes and its member's page roles, an upload's file is kept as a blob and LinkedIn's processing moves its status on the World clock, and a post waits on its media; the derived core owns none. The share box's Post makes the same writes as the API (shared.ts createPostAs, startImageUpload, putImage, startVideoUpload, putVideoPart, finishVideoUpload). Every operation of the written spec no row names is the gap, LinkedIn's 404.

decisions.demand: media senders/linkedin.mjs:52; the share box's Post (feed screen)
decisions.why: a post as a member or a page the caller holds a posting role on, with its media checked as the author's and still processing or ready; 201 with x-restli-id and no body; a post whose media is processing is PUBLISH_REQUESTED until LinkedIn publishes it

decisions.demand: the Posts page's get by URN (READER and AUTHOR), replayed from its examples; the refresh of a post the World holds
decisions.why: the post in the view asked for (READER: published only), for a caller with r_organization_social and a role on the author page

decisions.demand: the life's look over the page's posts the week after launch, and the analytics collector the daily limit meets
decisions.why: an author's posts, newest by lastModifiedAt or createdAt, paged by start and count with a next link

decisions.demand: the life's rehearsal post, taken down before launch
decisions.why: the post gone through the kernel's remove; a second delete answers 204 again, as LinkedIn's deletes are idempotent

decisions.demand: the share box's Photo (feed screen); the life's teaser card
decisions.why: an image registered WAITING_UPLOAD for an owner the caller may act as, with its upload URL and its expiry

decisions.demand: the share box's Photo (feed screen); the life's teaser card
decisions.why: the bytes PUT with the caller's token to the URL initializeUpload answered: kept as a blob, the image PROCESSING until LinkedIn makes it AVAILABLE or fails a file that is no JPG, GIF or PNG; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/images-api?view=li-lms-2026-09 states WAITING_UPLOAD waits for upload and PROCESSING generates artifacts, but documents no repeated PUT/finalize refusal. Where documentation stops, a request after WAITING_UPLOAD is refused with HTTP 400 in the LinkedIn error envelope and INVALID_VALUE_FOR_FIELD; the upload-retry acts in the life walk this ruling, without claiming the message is vendor-published.

decisions.demand: the life's check that the teaser card is AVAILABLE
decisions.why: the image and its downloadUrl once processed, for a caller whose scopes may read images

Where documentation stops, a request after WAITING_UPLOAD is refused with HTTP 400 in the LinkedIn error envelope and INVALID_VALUE_FOR_FIELD; the upload-retry acts in the life walk this ruling, without claiming the message is vendor-published.

decisions.demand: media senders/linkedin.mjs:32; the share box's Video (feed screen)
decisions.why: the parts named by their ETags in order joined into the file, kept as a blob, and the video PROCESSING until LinkedIn makes it AVAILABLE or fails a file that is no MP4 of three seconds to 30 minutes; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/videos-api?view=li-lms-2026-09 states WAITING_UPLOAD waits for upload and PROCESSING generates artifacts, but documents no repeated PUT/finalize refusal. decisions.demand: the life's first identity call: which pages the launch's member, Aaron, administers
decisions.why: the caller's own approved and requested roles, filtered by role and state

decisions.demand: the Organization Access Control page's find by organization (who administers a page), replayed from its examples
decisions.why: a page's roles, for its administrator

decisions.demand: the life's check that urn:li:organization:100000001 is videogame.ai's page, the one the sender posts as
decisions.why: the page with every field, for its administrator; anyone else 403

decisions.demand: Mira's who-posted tool asking whose sign-in token it holds (the life); Sign In with LinkedIn's userinfo
decisions.why: the member's subject, names and locale, and their email with the email scope; unversioned at /v2

decisions.demand: A person signs up at linkedin.com/signup.
decisions.why: Member signup creates the LinkedIn account outside the marketing REST API.

decisions.demand: A member creates a company page and becomes its administrator.
decisions.why: Create a LinkedIn Page is a website action; the API reads the page and its roles.

decisions.demand: Create an application and request its products on the Developer Portal.
decisions.why: The Developer Portal issues the application's client credentials outside the marketing API.

decisions.demand: Generate an approved member token for an application.
decisions.why: The Developer Portal's OAuth Token Generator Tool supplies the member grant used by API calls.

decisions.demand: Read an application's endpoint limits from its Analytics tab.
decisions.why: Standard rate limits are not published in the API; the declared door records the limits the portal shows.

decisions.demand: Supply the deployment's developer application and first member's OAuth grant.
decisions.why: Application registration and the member grant are console actions; the credential door retains their native app and token.
